newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Polish ex-president Lech Walesa leaves Taiwan for Japan.
Taiwan expected to participate in world semiconductor industry forum.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Several more officials targetted in justice ministry's anti-crime sweep.
Taiwan to grant permanent residency to certain foreigners.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - United States to hold presidential elections tomorrow (Tuesday).
Economic ministry secretly postpones policy of pushing for investments in southern Asia.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Polls show President Clinton's lead over Bob Dole narrowing.
Wall Street concerned about possible takeover of U.S. Congress by Democratic Party.
